subject: Estimate handoff — quick check & ops walkthrough
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novara.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Estimate handoff — quick check & ops walkthrough
Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_Novara_v1.pdf (pdf, 42KB), SOW-draft-20280508.docx (docx, 18KB)

Hi Samir / Liz —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the attached estimate:  
- Scope: serving roadmap for inference across 3 services (chat, embeddings, reranking) on Dedicated capacity.  
- Timeline: POC within 4–6 weeks, production readiness ~10–12 weeks with integration and testing.  
- Cost: high-level estimate attached (monthly committed capacity + token overage model). See Redwood_Estimate_Novara_v1.pdf.  

Next steps I proposed on the call:  
1) Review the attached estimate and SOW draft internally — comment on scope or ask for adjustments.  
2) Ops runthrough (20–30m) with Connor to walk through infra, VPN/VPC options, and deployment checklist.  
3) If that looks good, we can draft an order form and schedule a short legal/procurement sync.  

Can you confirm you received the estimate? If yes, I can have Connor run the ops walkthrough — here are a few slots: Wed 5/10 10:00–10:30 PT, Thu 5/11 11:00–11:30 PT, Fri 5/12 09:30–10:00 PT. (Or send a time that works and we’ll accommodate.)  

Link to the HubSpot deal and calendar slots: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/8912 and https://cal.example.com/marissa/slots

Thanks — happy to adjust scope if you see anything off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

---
Redwood_Estimate_Novara_v1.pdf — contains: capacity tiers, unit economics, estimated monthly cost ranges.
SOW-draft-20280508.docx — draft scope for POC + production rollout.

Thanks — I got the estimate and SOW. Quick read-through this afternoon looks reasonable; I need to run this by our engineering leads (Liz) and procurement.  

We got pulled into a last-minute customer ask so timeline might slip a bit on our side. Ops walkthrough would be helpful — could we aim for early next week? I’ll sync with Liz and circle back with availability.

Appreciate the clear next steps.

Connor — looping you in to pick the meeting and cover the technical checklist.

Best,
Marissa
